hooks.name: Validate CDK stack after infra change
hooks.description: Validate CDK infra changes and check Bedrock/IAM permissions are correct after infra/app.py is saved

action.prompt: infra/app.py was saved. Run `cd infra && .venv/bin/python app.py 2>&1` to synth the CDK stack. If synthesis fails, diagnose and fix the issue. Also verify: (1) all Lambda functions have the bedrock:Converse + bedrock:InvokeModel IAM policy, (2) stage_fn has iot:CreateJob permission, (3) the Step Functions approval step uses WAIT_FOR_TASK_TOKEN. Report the resource count in the synth output.
